storyCards.headline: Set Adrift On Memory Bliss: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
P.m. Dawn's "Set Adrift On Memory Bliss" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Set Adrift On Memory Bliss was released in 1991.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
